versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

brand-jingle-studio 0.1.1

- Initial release of Brand Jingle Studio, a tool to create original brand jingles, ad songs, and audio-logo stings for commercial use.
- Supports generating sung hooks, instrumental stings, or spoken taglines across various campaign destinations (ads, intros, store openings, etc.).
- Delivers three style sketches first; allows users to lock one, then derive other lengths and versions as needed.
- Includes clear routing for requests best served by adjacent skills (personal songs, video beds, playlists, covers, etc.).
- Ensures clear confirmation and billing steps before any paid music or voice synthesis work begins.
